english.title: Pilot fly aircraft below height of 500 feet
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) failed to comply with rules 3105 and 5005(f) of the Standardised European Rules of the Air, in that the aircraft, namely **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF AIRCRAFT..) flew below the minimum height allowed under VFR, namely

(A)_[500 feet above the ground or water]_
(B)_[500 feet above the highest obstacle within a radius of 500 feet from that aircraft]_

other than when taking off or landing or with the permission of the CAA
english.legislation: Contrary to rules 3105 and 5005(f) of the Standardised European Rules of the Air, Article 265(6) of, and Part 2 of Schedule 13 to, the Air Navigation Order 2016.
